### RequestUserStats

```ts
sdk.SteamGameServerStats.RequestUserStats(steamIDUser: bigint | number): Promise<GSStatsReceived_t>
```

```cpp
SteamAPICall_t RequestUserStats( CSteamID steamIDUser )
```

> downloads stats for the user
> returns a GSStatsReceived_t callback when completed
> if the user has no stats, GSStatsReceived_t.m_eResult will be set to k_EResultFail
> these stats will only be auto-updated for clients playing on the server. For other
> users you'll need to call RequestUserStats() again to refresh any data

| Parameter | C++ type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `steamIDUser` | `CSteamID` |  |

Returns a Promise of [`GSStatsReceived_t`](../callbacks.md#gsstatsreceived_t).

Valve: <https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamGameServerStats#RequestUserStats>

### StoreUserStats

```ts
sdk.SteamGameServerStats.StoreUserStats(steamIDUser: bigint | number): Promise<GSStatsStored_t>
```

```cpp
SteamAPICall_t StoreUserStats( CSteamID steamIDUser )
```

> Store the current data on the server, will get a GSStatsStored_t callback when set.
>
> If the callback has a result of k_EResultInvalidParam, one or more stats
> uploaded has been rejected, either because they broke constraints
> or were out of date. In this case the server sends back updated values.
> The stats should be re-iterated to keep in sync.

| Parameter | C++ type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `steamIDUser` | `CSteamID` |  |

Returns a Promise of [`GSStatsStored_t`](../callbacks.md#gsstatsstored_t).

Valve: <https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamGameServerStats#StoreUserStats>
